title: Missing HSTS (Strict-Transport-Security)
impact: Browsers may use plaintext HTTP, enabling SSL-strip downgrade.

title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
impact: No CSP increases XSS blast radius and data-exfiltration risk.

title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
impact: MIME sniffing can turn uploads/responses into script execution.

title: Missing X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors
impact: Page may be framed for clickjacking.

title: Open port 8080/http-alt
remediation: Confirm the service is required and intentionally exposed.

title: Server version disclosed in banner
impact: Version disclosure aids targeted exploitation of known CVEs.
remediation: Suppress or genericise the Server header.
